description: This file is a JUnit test class for testing the behavior of CheckLoanRepaymentDueBusinessStep in the Apache Fineract project. It contains unit tests that verify whether business events are correctly raised based on loan repayment due dates and configuration settings.

classes.name: CheckLoanRepaymentDueBusinessStepTest
classes.description: Unit test class for CheckLoanRepaymentDueBusinessStep, testing its behavior in raising business events based on loan repayment schedules and configuration.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes context and the object under test before each test case.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Resets thread-local context after each test case.

methods.name: givenLoanWithInstallmentDueAfterConfiguredDaysWhenStepExecutionThenBusinessEventIsRaised
methods.description: Tests that a business event is raised when a loan installment is due after the configured days.

methods.name: givenLoanWithNoInstallmentDueAfterConfiguredDaysWhenStepExecutionThenNoBusinessEventIsRaised
methods.description: Tests that no business event is raised when the loan installment due date is beyond the threshold.

methods.name: givenLoanWithInstallmentDueAfterConfiguredDaysInLoanProductWhenStepExecutionThenBusinessEventIsRaised
methods.description: Tests that a business event is raised when the loan product explicitly sets due days for repayment event.
